misc.text: #ONEPIECE1190 Another insane sword ability: Imu BoneEater’s weapon strikes Gaban’s hand. Nothing happens at first, but later, when Gaban launches his attack and Imu activates his sword’s ability, Gaban loses his hand instantly. It’s such a brutal ability, a single clean hit is enough to sever your body parts.
